reason: No account and everything on my phone gets me to download it and try the free first summary, but I'm not paying until I've seen for myself that nothing leaves my phone and the summary actually tells me if metformin or inositol is doing anything. I already pay for a PCOS program, so this has to earn its place first.
objection: Every period app says it's private until it isn't. 'Optional AI write-up' still means my data can go somewhere, and I can't check what an app really does with it.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor actually used the free summary at my next appointment and it saved me from explaining my whole history again, I'd pay the $7.99 for the one after that.
